activate.title: Activate AI
activate.subtitle: Run plant recognition on your own PC.
activate.how: Recognition runs on your PC (an NVIDIA card is required), not on our servers. Install the worker on your machine, keep it on, and the app identifies your plants using your own GPU.
activate.statusHint: Create a token, paste it into the worker on your PC, and keep it running.
activate.tokenOnce: Copy it now: it won't be shown again.
activate.error: The operation failed. Please try again.
